note: Plugin manifest for UARTScope Pro. `module` is resolved relative to this file. Point UARTSCOPE_PLUGIN_REGISTRY at a URL to use a hosted registry instead of this bundled one.

plugins.name: LIN Bus (LDF)
plugins.author: UARTScope Community
plugins.description: LIN bus frames: frame ID, protected PID, 1-8 data bytes, and a checksum check. Signal mapping for five common LDF frames.

plugins.name: J1939 (Heavy Duty)
plugins.author: UARTScope Community
plugins.description: SAE J1939 for trucks, buses and agricultural vehicles. PGN-based message parsing with source-address and priority extraction.

plugins.name: DALI Lighting
plugins.author: UARTScope Community
plugins.description: DALI / DALI-2 lighting control. Forward and backward frames, broadcast, group and scene addressing.
